# Ridu 0.22.0

Collection lists read only the fields they show, so a long rich-text body no longer travels with
every row. `select` no longer changes what field read rules and read hooks see, which closes a way
around rules that check another field. Lists read per-row permissions in batches.

## Security

- A field read rule that checks another field of the same document, like the `membersOnly` example
  in the access-control guide, could be bypassed with `select`. Ridu removed the unselected fields
  before it ran read rules and read hooks, so `select={"url":true}` hid `membersOnly` from the
  rule. A rule that treats a missing value as allowed then returned the field. Related documents
  loaded with a target `select` in `populate` had the same gap. When a collection has read hooks or
  field read rules, Ridu now reads the whole stored document, runs them, and only then keeps the
  selected fields.

## Breaking changes

- Custom list cells (`listCellRenderers`) and list layouts (`listResultsRenderers`) receive
  documents holding only the ID, timestamps, title field, visible columns and the fields they
  declare. A cell or layout that reads any other field must name it in the new `fields` option,
  for example `fields: ['status']`. Ridu checks the names when it builds the admin. See
  [Custom table cells](https://riducms.com/docs/custom-components/list-cells/) and
  [Show collection results as cards](https://riducms.com/docs/custom-components/list-results/).

## Changes

- The admin collection list reads only what it shows: each document's ID, timestamps, title field
  and visible columns, the parent field in a hierarchy, and the fields that custom cells or a list
  layout declare. Search, filters and sorting still run in the database on any field. See
  [Browse content](https://riducms.com/docs/browsing-content/#use-the-list).
- Relationship and upload fields named in `fields` arrive as the related document's ID and title,
  like a relationship column, whether or not their column is visible. A custom cell's own `value`
  is always the saved value.
- A list page records the columns and fields it was read for. When a navigation brings a page read
  for another column layout, for example after another tab saved its own, the list reads it again
  instead of showing empty cells.
- Lists with `includeAccess` and the admin's select-all read per-row permissions in batches: one
  read for the page's documents, and one for each distinct predicate a filtered access rule
  returns, instead of reads for every row. A 10-row page whose update and delete rules return
  filters makes 3 reads instead of about 30. `readVersions` on a versioned collection is still
  counted for each row.

## Upgrade

Update the Go module and all Ridu npm packages to 0.22.0 together, and rebuild the admin and
application binary.

If a custom list cell reads `document` fields other than its own column, or a list layout reads
anything besides the title, add those field names to the registration's `fields`. Reads that
select fields from a collection with read hooks or field read rules now read whole documents
internally; responses change only where a rule now sees the fields it checks.

Ridu requires Go 1.26.9 or newer. Go 1.27.0 and 1.27.1 meet that minimum but still have the
standard-library vulnerabilities described in the 0.20.0 notes, so build and deploy with Go 1.26.9
or a later 1.26 release, or with Go 1.27.2 or later.
